# OSB scope. Hatred of All Nations: every other country, once each - a country
# flag on the target records that the Order already hates it, so countries
# that appear later are caught by the monthly pass (on_monthly_OSB).
wif_osb_hatred_apply = {
	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_osb_hated }
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_osb_hated
		ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = wif_osb_hatred } }
	}
}
